notes: Source of truth for all simulation parameters. Regenerate the Dart mirror with `dart run tools/gen_params.dart`. Every numeric entry is {value, source, note?}. Values marked 'initial estimate' must be verified in task T-103.

cellSizeM.source: Zensus 2022 100 m grid (Destatis, dl-de/by-2.0); 1 tile = 1 ha

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 34.07a.02 artenreiche frische (Mäh-)Weide = 18 (34.07a.01 Mähwiese = 20, 34.08a.01 Intensivgrünland = 8); modelled as extensive grassland developing from intensive to species-rich

recoveryMonths.source: BfN-Schriften 721 / Kompensationspraxis: Entwicklung artenreichen Grünlands 10–15 Jahre

airSink.source: Nowak et al. 2006 deposition magnitudes; grass minor (initial estimate)

shade.source: InVEST Urban Cooling: shade = canopy fraction

albedo.source: InVEST Urban Cooling biophysical table example values

eti.source: InVEST Urban Cooling crop coefficient Kc scaled 0–1

greenWeight.source: design: recreational usability of open meadow

co2PerHaYear.source: UBA / Thünen: grassland soil carbon sink ~1 t CO2/ha/a (initial estimate)

jobsPerHa.source: Destatis Landwirtschaftszählung: ~1 AK je 50 ha; rounded up for game

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 33.0x.03 Acker mit stark verarmter oder fehlender Segetalvegetation = 6

greenWeight.source: design: fields are walkable at the edge only

co2PerHaYear.source: UBA: cropland net source incl. fertiliser N2O (initial estimate)

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 43.07.05M Buchen(misch)wald frischer basenreicher Standorte, mittlere Ausprägung = 16; 43.07.02M Eichen-Hainbuchenwald mittlere Ausprägung = 20; mean 18

biotopeStart.source: BKompV Anlage 2: young plantation below Vorwald (42.03.02 Vorwald frischer Standorte = 13); 0.4·18 ≈ 7

recoveryMonths.source: BKompV Anlage 2 distinguishes junge / mittlere / alte Ausprägung; mittlere Ausprägung after ~20–40 years

airSink.source: Nowak et al. 2006 (i-Tree): urban trees remove up to few % of PM/NO2 locally; scaled to 20 % of local index (initial estimate)

greenWeight.source: design: forest walks highly valued (WHO urban green space review)

co2PerHaYear.source: Thünen Bundeswaldinventur: ~10 t CO2/ha/a net sink in growing forest (initial estimate)

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 24.03b sonstige natürliche mesotrophe Gewässer = 19; constructed pond assumed below natural, 16

biotopeStart.source: design: new pond matures over years

eti.source: InVEST Urban Cooling: open water evaporation

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 51.06a.03 intensiv gepflegte Parkanlage mit altem Baumbestand = 13 (51.06a.02.01 extensiv gepflegt = 16)

biotopeStart.source: BKompV Anlage 2: park without old trees; grows into 13 as trees age

greenWeight.source: design: park is the reference recreation space (WHO 300 m rule)

sealing.source: BauNVO WR/WA GRZ 0.4 plus roads (initial estimate)

noiseEmissionDb.source: TA Lärm: residential background; own traffic (initial estimate)

shade.source: InVEST Urban Cooling: shade = canopy fraction; garden trees over ~15 % of an EFH plot

eti.source: InVEST Urban Cooling: lawns and gardens ~40 % of plot, Kc ~0.7

co2PerHaYear.source: UBA: ~2 t CO2/EW/a Wohnen bei 45 EW/ha, minus gardens (initial estimate)

noiseNightReductionDb.source: design: household activity falls at night; TA Larm night limits sit 15 dB below day limits for residential areas

residentsPerHa.source: Derived: GFZ 1.2 (BauNVO §17 Obergrenze WA/MI) × 10 000 m² × 0.8 net = 9 600 m² ÷ 49.2 m²/EW (Destatis, Ende 2024) = 195 EW/ha net; ~180 gross

sealing.source: BauNVO WA/MI GRZ 0.6 plus roads (initial estimate)

noiseEmissionDb.source: TA Lärm: urban residential background (initial estimate)

co2PerHaYear.source: UBA: heating per EW lower in multi-family, 180 EW/ha (initial estimate)

noiseNightReductionDb.source: design: household activity falls at night; TA Larm night limits sit 15 dB below day limits for residential areas

retailFloorM2.source: design: 20 % of 1 ha plot as retail floor; HDE 1.4 m²/EW

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 53.01.14a Industrie- und Gewerbefläche inkl. typischen Freiräumen = 2

noiseEmissionDb.source: TA Lärm GE limit 65 day; delivery traffic typical 55–60 at boundary (initial estimate)

noiseNightReductionDb.source: design: shops and deliveries stop overnight, leaving only plant and car-park movements

jobsPerHa.source: BBSR Flächenkennwerte: produzierendes Gewerbe 30–60 Beschäftigte/ha (initial estimate)

sealing.source: BauNVO GI GRZ 0.8 plus yards (initial estimate)

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 53.01.14a Industrie- und Gewerbefläche inkl. typischen Freiräumen = 2

noiseEmissionDb.source: TA Lärm GI limit 70 day; typical plant boundary 60–68 (initial estimate)

airEmission.source: EMEP/EEA: industrial combustion and processes dominate local PM/NOx (initial estimate, relative units)

co2PerHaYear.source: UBA Emissionsdaten Industrie je Beschäftigten, scaled to 45 Besch./ha (initial estimate)

noiseNightReductionDb.source: design: partial night shift; TA Larm regulates night separately, so a compliant plant throttles rather than stops

biotopeValue.source: BKompV Anlage 2: 52.01.01a versiegelter Verkehrs- und Betriebsweg = 0

noiseEmissionDb.source: Sound power of one 100 m segment at the 50 m reference, calibrated so that the energetic sum of segments gives L_den ≈ 58 dB(A) at 100 m and ≈ 65 dB(A) at 25 m from a straight road with 10 000 Kfz/24h at 50 km/h (RLS-19 / CNOSSOS-EU orders of magnitude)

airEmission.source: EMEP/EEA road transport NOx/PM at 10 000 Kfz/24h (relative unit 1.0)

co2PerHaYear.source: traffic CO2 is computed from commute km, not per tile

buildCostKEur.source: Hauptstraße ~2–4 M€/km inkl. Knoten → 100 m Abschnitt (initial estimate)

maintenanceKEurYear.source: Straßenerhaltung 1.5–3 €/m² Fahrbahn/a (Difu/KfW Kommunalpanel: Erhaltungsbedarf) für ~2 000 m² Fahrbahn je 100 m Hauptstraße plus Beleuchtung, Reinigung, Winterdienst ≈ 10 k€/a

noiseNightReductionDb.source: RLS-19 / typical German urban day-night split: about 10% of daily traffic falls in the 8 night hours against 90% in the 16 day hours, so the hourly rate is 0.22 of the day rate and 10*log10(0.22) = -6.5 dB

areaReferenceDistanceM.source: half tile: boundary of a 1 ha area source; roads are split into 100 m segments (CNOSSOS-EU point-source segmentation)

areaDecayDbPerDecade.source: ISO 9613-2 / CNOSSOS-EU: geometric divergence of a point source, 6 dB per doubling; summing segments reproduces the 3 dB/doubling of a line

foliageAttenuationDbPerTile.source: ISO 9613-2 Table A.2 foliage attenuation up to ~10 dB over 200 m; simplified per 100 m tile

buildingScreeningDbPerTile.source: CNOSSOS-EU diffraction; dense building row typical 5–10 dB (initial estimate)

backgroundDb.source: TA Lärm: rural night background (initial estimate)

baselineThroughTraffic.source: design: any main road carries some through traffic

limitDayDb.source: TA Lärm: allgemeines Wohngebiet (WA) Tag 55 dB(A)

limitBadDb.source: TA Lärm: Gewerbegebiet 65; used as 0-score for residents

nightGuidelineDb.source: WHO Environmental Noise Guidelines for the European Region (2018): road traffic Lnight below 45 dB (strong recommendation); Lden below 53 dB

nightLoaelDb.source: WHO Night Noise Guidelines for Europe (2009): Lnight,outside 40 dB is the guideline value and the lowest observed adverse effect level

nightHighRiskDb.source: WHO Night Noise Guidelines for Europe (2009): 55 dB is the interim target; above it cardiovascular effects become the major public health concern

decayLengthM.source: simplified Gaussian-plume near-field; EMEP/EEA guidance for street-scale gradients (initial estimate)

sinkRadiusTiles.source: Nowak et al.: local deposition effect within ~300 m (initial estimate)

indexScale.source: calibration T-114: uniform housing_high + traffic (C≈0.4) → index ≈ 67; inside an industrial area (C≈3) → index ≈ 5

windFromDegrees.source: DWD: prevailing wind in Germany is from the south-west; meteorological convention, the direction the wind blows FROM. Only acts when windSpeedMs > 0.

windSpeedMs.source: design: calm by default so a scenario opts into wind through paramOverrides; DWD annual means for German lowlands are 3-4 m/s at 10 m

windStretchPerMs.source: Gaussian plume (Pasquill-Gifford): advection lengthens the plume downwind roughly in proportion to wind speed; 0.35 per m/s puts a 3 m/s wind at about twice the downwind reach

uhiMaxC.source: InVEST Urban Cooling: UHI_max is a user input (rural–urban maximum difference); DWD reports 2–4 K for German mid-size cities

greenPatchMinHa.source: InVEST Urban Cooling: green areas larger than 2 ha have an additional cooling effect

coolingDistanceTiles.source: InVEST Urban Cooling default d_cool = 450 m; game uses 3 tiles (300 m)

greenRadiusTiles.source: WHO Urban green spaces 2016: ≥0.5 ha within 300 m; 3-30-300 rule (Konijnendijk 2021)

retailM2PerResident.source: HDE Zahlenspiegel: ~1.4 m² Verkaufsfläche je Einwohner

retailReferenceSupply.source: calibration: one commercial tile at 300 m = full score (2000/3²)

jobDecayM.source: MiD 2017: median commute ~ 10 km, but local job access decays within few km (initial estimate)

jobReferenceJobs.source: calibration: ~one commercial + one industry tile within 500 m = full score, T-114

speciesAreaZ.source: Arrhenius / MacArthur–Wilson: z ≈ 0.25–0.35 for habitat islands

weight.source: InVEST HQ sample threat table: roads

modeShareByDistance.source: MiD 2017 Ergebnisbericht (BMVI/infas) and MiD 2017 Analysen zum Rad- und Fußverkehr: walking dominates below 1 km but car already notable; cycling peaks at 1–1.5 km (21 %); car dominant from 1.5 km; commuting overall ≈ two thirds car, 21 % bike, 14 % walk

roadSearchRadiusTiles.source: design: 300 m to a main road counts as connected

externalCommuteKm.source: MiD 2017: mean commute ~ 16 km for out-commuters (initial estimate)

referenceCommuteKm.source: MiD 2017: mean one-way commute ≈ 16–17 km; a mean of 20 km scores zero on the distance half of the commuting indicator

incomeTaxPerResidentYear.source: Destatis PM 126/2025: Gemeindeanteil Einkommensteuer 46.1 Mrd € (2024) ÷ 83.6 Mio EW ≈ 550 €

propertyTaxPerResidentYear.source: Destatis PM N006/2025: Grundsteuer B 15.1 Mrd € (2023) ÷ 84 Mio EW ≈ 180 €

businessTaxPerJobYear.source: Destatis PM 356/2024: Gewerbesteuer 75.1 Mrd € (2023) ÷ ~35 Mio SV-Beschäftigte ≈ 2 100 €

startBudgetKEur.source: design: enough for a 12-tile main road plus a mixed quarter of ~25 tiles

immigrationRate.source: design: new housing fills within ~2 years at high attractiveness

unconnectedAttractivenessFactor.source: design: no main road within 300 m

attractivenessWeights.source: design; relative importance from Wohnzufriedenheit surveys (BBSR) (initial estimate)

amplitude.source: design: 0 disables the yearly cycle entirely and reproduces the season-free model; a scenario can turn it down through paramOverrides

growth.source: DWD: the vegetation period in Germany runs roughly April to October, and evapotranspiration follows it. Monthly factors are scaled to average 1.0 over the year, so only the distribution within a year changes, not the annual total.

heat.source: Urban heat island intensity peaks in summer and is weak in winter (DWD Klimareport / UHI literature). Scaled to average 1.0 over the year.
